name: Suisui -sweetheart swimmer-
source:
Shouji is in love with his childhood friend, Medaka. When his mother told him that he has a fiancee, he ran away from home. Then his mother told him, "I don't care with whom, but you should marry after school graduation." Thus he started to live in Medaka's house in another city, and started to attend her school (originally an all-girls school).

After that, his fiancee, Toki, was also forced to go to this school. She forced him to help to establish and join the swimming club since he accidentally saw her panties. Medaka and her friend also joined the new club. Their exciting swimming club activity starts...
translation:
庄司爱着自己的青梅竹马目高。母亲告诉他已有未婚妻后，他离家出走。随后母亲又对他说：“无论和谁都可以，但你应该在毕业后结婚。”于是，他开始寄住在另一座城市的目高家，并转入她所在的学校（原本是一所女子学校）。

之后，他的未婚妻时也被迫进入这所学校。由于庄司无意间看见了她的内裤，她便强迫他协助创办游泳部并加入社团。目高与她的朋友也加入了新成立的游泳部。令人兴奋的社团活动就此开始……
